U inside the filter's results returns the archived row to the default list
`t` previews a theme live on the real list and reverts to the exact original colour on esc
a settings takeover save of ui.theme changes the running client's own render live, read per cell (requirement 19)
Shift+PgUp/PgDn scroll the interactive grid's own scrollback
reaping a deleted session removes its store rows and deck's own per-session files, but never the audit log's earlier history
| cycles auto -> side-by-side -> stacked -> collapsed -> auto
